use default
use Raster.IMAGE

let width = 512
let height = 256
let band = height / 4

let image = IMAGE(width, height)

for quarter in 0..4 do
    let bars = 8 << quarter
    let bar_width = width / bars
    let top = cast double(quarter * band)

    for bar in 0..bars do
        let step = if quarter % 2 == 0 then bar else bars - 1 - bar fi
        let grey = cast ubyte(255 * step / (bars - 1))
        let left = cast double(bar * bar_width)
        let right = left + cast double(bar_width)

        image.colour(grey, grey, grey)
        image.fill_rectangle(
            left, top, right, top + cast double(band))
    od

    write_line("row {quarter + 1}: {bars} bars of {bar_width} pixels")
od

image.write("bars.png")

image.show("bars.png")
